exercise_groups.group_title: BÀI TẬP CÂU BỊ ĐỘNG 1: CHUYỂN CÁC CÂU SAU SANG BỊ ĐỘNG (25 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Viết lại các câu sau sang thể bị động:

questions.prompt: 1. My father waters this flower every morning.
answers: is watered by my father every morning.
is watered every morning by my father.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại đơn: S số ít + is + V3/ed (watered) + by O + Time.

questions.prompt: 2. John invited Fiona to his birthday party last night.
answers: was invited to John's birthday party last night.
was invited to his birthday party last night by John.
was invited to his birthday party last night.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ đơn: was invited + cụm nơi chốn + thời gian.

questions.prompt: 3. Her mother is preparing the dinner in the kitchen.
answers: is being prepared in the kitchen by her mother.
is being prepared by her mother in the kitchen.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại tiếp diễn: is being + V3/ed (prepared). Trật tự: Place (in the kitchen) + by O.

questions.prompt: 4. We should clean our teeth twice a day.
answers: should be cleaned twice a day.
questions.explanation: Modal verb: should + be + V3/ed (cleaned). 'by us' được lược bỏ.

questions.prompt: 5. Our teachers have explained English grammar.
answers: has been explained by our teachers.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành: English grammar là danh từ không đếm được ➔ has been explained.

questions.prompt: 6. Some drunk drivers caused the accident in this city.
answers: was caused in this city by some drunk drivers.
was caused by some drunk drivers in this city.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ đơn: was caused + Place (in this city) + by O.

questions.prompt: 7. Tom will visit his parents next month.
answers: will be visited by Tom next month.
will be visited next month by Tom.
questions.explanation: Tương lai đơn: will be visited + by O + Time (next month).

questions.prompt: 8. The manager didn’t phone the secretary this morning.
answers: wasn't phoned by the manager this morning.
was not phoned by the manager this morning.
questions.explanation: Phủ định quá khứ đơn: wasn't / was not phoned + by O.

questions.prompt: 9. Did Mary buy this beautiful dress?
answers: this beautiful dress bought by Mary?
questions.explanation: Nghi vấn quá khứ đơn: Was + S + V3/ed (bought) + by Mary?

questions.prompt: 10. I won’t hang these old pictures in the living room.
answers: won't be hung in the living room.
will not be hung in the living room.
questions.explanation: Tương lai đơn: won't be + V3 (hung). Lược bỏ 'by me'.

questions.prompt: 11. The German didn’t build this factory during the Second World War.
answers: wasn't built by the German during the Second World War.
was not built by the German during the Second World War.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ đơn: wasn't built + by the German + thời gian.

questions.prompt: 12. The Greens are going to paint this house and these cars for Christmas Day.
answers: are going to be painted by the Greens for Christmas Day.
are going to be painted for Christmas Day by the Greens.
questions.explanation: Tương lai gần: are going to be painted (chủ ngữ số nhiều).

questions.prompt: 13. Ann had fed the cats before she went to the cinema.
answers: had been fed by Ann before she went to the cinema.
questions.explanation: Quá khứ hoàn thành: had been + V3 (fed).

questions.prompt: 14. The students have discussed the pollution problems since last week.
answers: have been discussed by the students since last week.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành số nhiều: have been discussed.

questions.prompt: 15. Have the thieves stolen the most valuable painting in the national museum?
answers: the most valuable painting in the national museum been stolen by the thieves?
questions.explanation: Nghi vấn HTHT: Has + S (painting) + been stolen + by the thieves?

questions.prompt: 16. Some people will interview the new president on TV.
answers: will be interviewed on TV.
questions.explanation: Tương lai đơn: will be interviewed. Bỏ 'by some people' vì không xác định.

questions.prompt: 17. How many languages do they speak in Canada?
answers: are spoken in Canada?
questions.explanation: Câu hỏi thì HTĐ: are spoken in Canada? Lược bỏ 'by them'.

questions.prompt: 18. Are you going to repair those shoes?
answers: those shoes going to be repaired?
questions.explanation: Nghi vấn tương lai gần: Are those shoes going to be repaired?

questions.prompt: 19. He has broken his nose in a football match.
answers: has been broken in a football match.
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành: has been broken. Lược bỏ 'by him'.

questions.prompt: 20. Have you finished the above sentences?
answers: the above sentences been finished?
questions.explanation: Nghi vấn HTHT: Have the above sentences been finished?

questions.prompt: 21. When will you do the work?
answers: the work be done?
questions.explanation: Wh- question tương lai: When will + S (the work) + be done?

questions.prompt: 22. How are you going to deal with this problem?
answers: this problem going to be dealt with?
questions.explanation: Tương lai gần: How is this problem going to be dealt with?

questions.prompt: 23. How do you spend this amount of money?
answers: this amount of money spent?
questions.explanation: Hiện tại đơn: How is + S (this amount of money) + spent?

questions.prompt: 24. I wonder whether the board of directors will choose Susan or Jane for the position.
answers: Susan or Jane will be chosen for the position by the board of directors.
Susan or Jane will be chosen by the board of directors for the position.
questions.explanation: Chuyển vế sau whether sang bị động: will be chosen by the board of directors.

questions.prompt: 25. How did the police find the lost man?
answers: the lost man found by the police?
questions.explanation: Nghi vấn quá khứ đơn: How was + S (the lost man) + found by the police?

exercise_groups.group_title: BÀI TẬP CÂU BỊ ĐỘNG 1: CHIA DẠNG ĐÚNG Ở THỂ BỊ ĐỘNG (CÂU 26 - 30)
exercise_groups.instruction: Điền dạng đúng của động từ trong ngoặc ở thể bị động:

questions.prompt: 26. A bottle was [blank] (throw) outsides last night by him.
answers: thrown
questions.explanation: Đã có sẵn 'was' (quá khứ) ➔ cần V3 của throw là 'thrown'.

questions.prompt: 27. This fan has already [blank] (fix) by my father.
answers: been fixed
questions.explanation: Hiện tại hoàn thành bị động: has already + been fixed.

questions.prompt: 28. Now, a test [blank] (do) by him to prepare for his exam.
answers: is being done
questions.explanation: Có dấu hiệu 'Now' ➔ Hiện tại tiếp diễn bị động: is being done.

questions.prompt: 29. Finally, the key [blank] (find).
answers: was found
has been found
questions.explanation: Diễn tả hành động đã xảy ra xong: was found (hoặc has been found).

questions.prompt: 30. They were very worried that the work would not [blank] (finish).
answers: be finished
questions.explanation: Sau 'would not' là dạng nguyên mẫu bị động: be finished.

exercise_groups.group_title: BÀI TẬP CÂU BỊ ĐỘNG 2: CÂU 2 TÂN NGỮ & CẤU TRÚC ĐẶC BIỆT (20 CÂU)
exercise_groups.instruction: Chuyển các câu sau sang bị động (lưu ý câu có 2 tân ngữ):

questions.prompt: 1. The waiter brings me this dish.
answers: is brought to me by the waiter.
is brought to me.
questions.explanation: HTĐ: This dish is brought to me by the waiter.

questions.prompt: 2. Our friends send these postcards to us.
answers: are sent to us by our friends.
questions.explanation: HTĐ số nhiều: These postcards are sent to us by our friends.

questions.prompt: 3. Their grandmother told them this story when they visited her last week.
answers: told this story by their grandmother when they visited her last week.
told this story when they visited her last week by their grandmother.
questions.explanation: Chuyển tân ngữ chỉ người 'them' ➔ They were told this story by their grandmother...

questions.prompt: 4. Tim ordered this train ticket for his mother.
answers: was ordered for his mother by Tim.
was ordered by Tim for his mother.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: was ordered for his mother by Tim.

questions.prompt: 5. You didn’t show me the special cameras.
answers: shown the special cameras.
shown the special cameras by you.
questions.explanation: Phủ định QKĐ: I wasn't shown the special cameras.

questions.prompt: 6. She showed her ticket to the airline agent.
answers: was shown to the airline agent.
was shown to the airline agent by her.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: Her ticket was shown to the airline agent.

questions.prompt: 7. He lends his friend his new shoes.
answers: is lent his new shoes by him.
is lent his new shoes.
questions.explanation: HTĐ: His friend is lent his new shoes.

questions.prompt: 8. She left her relatives five million pounds.
answers: was left to her relatives.
was left to her relatives by her.
were left to her relatives.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: Five million pounds was left to her relatives.

questions.prompt: 9. The shop assistant handed these boxes to the customer.
answers: were handed to the customer by the shop assistant.
questions.explanation: QKĐ số nhiều: were handed to the customer by the shop assistant.

questions.prompt: 10. The board awarded the first prize to the reporter.
answers: was awarded to the reporter by the board.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: was awarded to the reporter by the board.

questions.prompt: 11. Have you sent the Christmas cards to your family?
answers: been sent to your family?
questions.explanation: Nghi vấn HTHT: Have the Christmas cards been sent to your family?

questions.prompt: 12. The committee appointed Alice as secretary for the meeting.
answers: was appointed as secretary for the meeting by the committee.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: Alice was appointed as secretary for the meeting by the committee.

questions.prompt: 13. He hides the broken cup in the drawer.
answers: is hidden in the drawer.
is hidden in the drawer by him.
questions.explanation: HTĐ: The broken cup is hidden in the drawer.

questions.prompt: 14. They keep this room tidy all the time.
answers: is kept tidy all the time.
questions.explanation: HTĐ giữ nguyên tính từ bổ nghĩa: is kept tidy all the time.

questions.prompt: 15. They all voted the party a great success.
answers: was voted a great success by all of them.
was voted a great success.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: The party was voted a great success.

questions.prompt: 16. We gave Ann some bananas and some flowers.
answers: was given some bananas and some flowers.
was given some bananas and some flowers by us.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: Ann was given some bananas and some flowers.

questions.prompt: 17. They moved the fridge into the living room.
answers: was moved into the living room.
questions.explanation: QKĐ: The fridge was moved into the living room. (Lược bỏ by them).

questions.prompt: 18. She bought some cups of tea for the visitors in the next room.
answers: were bought for the visitors in the next room.
were bought for the visitors in the next room by her.
questions.explanation: QKĐ số nhiều: were bought for the visitors in the next room.

questions.prompt: 19. They find the new project worthless.
answers: is found worthless.
questions.explanation: HTĐ: The new project is found worthless.

questions.prompt: 20. The secretary didn’t take the notebook to the manager.
answers: wasn't taken to the manager by the secretary.
was not taken to the manager by the secretary.
questions.explanation: Phủ định QKĐ: The notebook wasn't taken to the manager by the secretary.
